items.review_text: Amazing service! The owner has a professional manner and is easy to deal with. You can tell, most importantly, that he truly cares and is willing work with you. This company I highly recommend.

After the pipe in my upstairs bathroom blow last month water came trought the ceiling and soak the livingroom carpet I didnt know what company to ring but my neighber give me the phone number for Rapid Restore. Spoke to Megan on phone she send the crew almost imediatly they was here in about 40 mins maybe less. They drag in dehumidfiers big hoses fans and pull up the rug i never saw such machines. first night noise was crazy but they said need it to dry the place proper and they was right becaus the smell gone now. few days later another team show up to fix the drywall repaint and rehang the light fittings, honestly i cant even tell where the patch is, looks like new. price was coverd mostly by insureance still they help me fill the forms i dont understand them papers. if you got water exploding in the house dont wait just call these guys it save me a huge headache

Dan Uebel came to visit us after we called your company about our house flooding. After we called you to report flooding in our home, he came to see us. He noted that the "dryers" who were supposed to have done our house left some things undone. The previous company was not interested in these items, even though my husband had asked them.  Dan came out to give us new hope. We were given the answers we needed and also explained why certain things had to be done. Kudos, a good man. I'm sorry but grateful for him to do the job right.

Really impresive fast respone after the flood in my basemant. the crew arived quickly, checked every corner, and started dryng and dehumidifyng right away. they even did a few small repairs without hassel. comunication was clear and friendli throughout. i would 100% recomend them for any water damage job. five stars.

Great Job Flood Pros! !

Our business basement flooded on a weekend overnight. It was Sunday morning when I made the call and Jon was on site in 30 minutes. He had his machines in place for fast removal of all of the water. Once the water was removed he quickly went into the drying phase which saved the building from more damage and mold setting in. I am impressed by how he and his crew (Michelle, Chris, Jordan, Mike, & Richard!!!) took on this project and saw it all the way through step by step to the very end. Not only did Jon walk me through the process of restoring our building but he also handled all of the insurance parts. He was on site for the adjuster evaluation and dealt with ALL of the insurance company issues. Every email, text, call was answered or returned quickly. Michelle was key in dealing with the insurance company and getting materials. She made sure I had exactly what I wanted for this project. If I was not satisfied with how something went she made sure it was addressed and rectified quickly. I was asked for approvals on items to make sure it was how I wanted something done and was allowed to be involved in this project which was very valuable to me. They were all on time, professional, and respectful of me and the building. In short THEY DID WHAT THEY SAID THEY WERE GOING TO DO!! And they did it well in an appropriate amount of time. It was a joy to work with this team and I would have them handle any future projects in our business or home.
Their team arrived on time and gave the place a nice clean up, as though it were a well-operated machine.
I loved the service they really helped me and very professional.
After our roof leaked during a storm, the ceiling and walls were soaked. This team cleaned, dried, and treated everything for mold. The job was impressive, though a bit pricey.
